Darius Twin.name: Darius Twin
Darius Twin.summary: Darius Twin is a shoot 'em up video game released for the Super NES in 1991. It was the first new installment in the Darius series to not be originally designed for the arcades, and also the first to have a normal 4:3 screen-ratio. Interestingly, while it's a unique game in the Darius series, it appears to reuse sprites and background designs from Darius and Darius II. Also, while the names of the bosses are new, they really are reworkings of previous bosses for the most part.

Death and Return of Superman, The.name: The Death and Return of Superman
Death and Return of Superman, The.summary: Brace yourself for a hard-hitting fight to the finish that lets you relive the classic DC comic book series! As Superman, fight for your life against mighty Doomsday, the vile distributor of death and destruction! Then, control the destiny of the four Supermen - each claiming to be the one, true Superman! Explode through 10 levels of super-powered battles and fly at furious speeds - until only the real Superman is left standing!

Eyra - The Crow Maiden.name: Eyra: The Crow Maiden
Eyra - The Crow Maiden.summary:
Eyra the Crow Maiden is a new and original 8-bit video game for the Nintendo Entertainment System (NES). Inspired by the sword and sorcery genre, the world of Eyra takes inspiration from stories of characters like Conan the Barbarian, Red Sonja and Tarzan.

The game's gameplay and mechanics are based on titles such as Rastan Saga, Cadash, Castlevania, Blades of Vengeance and Jill of the Jungle.

A 16-bit version port of the game to Super Nintendo and Sega Genesis has also been announced as part of a stretch goal for the NES games Kickstarter campaign.

Madden NFL 96.name: Madden NFL 96
Madden NFL 96.summary: Madden NFL 96 is one of the earlier games in the long lasting franchise. It is the first to include a create-a-player feature that had the player preform mini games similar to real NFL drills. With 28 NFL teams and many more secret historic teams, Real NFL players, and the iconic NFL on Fox music theme, Madden 96 offered an authentic experience for fans of the sport.

Mario's Early Years - Fun with Letters.name: Mario's Early Years! Fun with Letters
Mario's Early Years - Fun with Letters.summary: Mario's Early Years: Fun With Letters is a collection of letter-related activities for kids ages 3 to 6. Playing with either Mario or Princess Toadstool, you select from 10 different activity worlds each filled with different activities that range from letter recognition to sentence fill-in, letter-sound recognition, vowel recognition, etc. Each activity can be played in either Discovery mode, where you are free to do what you wish, or in Learning mode, where Luigi guides you through the activities.
